cands.name: Aisha O. Dew
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 107 since January 2025. A political strategist and consultant, she has served as first vice chair of the NC Democratic Party and chair of the Mecklenburg County Democratic Party. She is political director for Higher Heights for America. Salem College graduate (2000).
cands.gaps: We could not find where Dew was born or raised, or when she came to North Carolina. The page we read shows no details of the bills she has sponsored. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police pay, gun laws, school choice or teacher pay. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, so her stated priorities come only from her 2024 survey. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements. Ballotpedia lists only small voter-guide groups as 2026 endorsers.

qual.background: Has held the NC House District 107 seat since January 2025. Before that she was a political strategist and consultant who worked on over 70 races, was Bernie Sanders' 2016 North Carolina state director, and is political director at Higher Heights for America.
qual.why: She has served in the legislature for about a year and has a long political-strategy career. That puts her in the middle-to-upper range. Her party chair and campaign roles are not government offices, and the pages show no law or budget career.
